Counted guideline exceptions: 6. More than 3 — Oversight Council approval required.
Mitigants considered for loan amount (Appendix A hierarchy): Increased borrower equity or cash injection; Lower leverage (reduced loan amount).

Mitigants considered for min dscr @ stabilization (Appendix A hierarchy): Lien on the guarantor's personal residence; Business plan to get to threshold; Subordination of all other debt (when ID is senior lender).
Mitigants considered for min equity (Appendix A hierarchy): Increased borrower equity or cash injection.
Mitigants considered for hard cost contingency for new construction (Appendix A hierarchy): Additional owner equity available for overruns; Fixed-price / GMP contract; Completion guaranty.
Mitigants considered for soft cost contingency for new construction (Appendix A hierarchy): Additional owner equity available for overruns; Fixed-price / GMP contract; Completion guaranty.
